raw_record.question_text:
Read the figure and answer the question.

<image1>

The island shown in the figure is located in what direction of which ocean?

method.method_draft: First describe the image as an island plotted on a latitude-longitude grid, with latitude labels around 13°20′, 13°30′, 13°40′ and longitude labels around 144°40′, 144°50′. Then use these coordinates to place the island on the globe: it is north of the equator and around 145°E, which falls in the western part of the Pacific Ocean. Since it is in the northern Pacific sector, answer that the island is in the northwestern Pacific Ocean.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是一座岛屿，绘在经纬度网格上；纬度标注约有13°20′、13°30′、13°40′，经度标注约有144°40′、144°50′，岛屿大致位于13°多的纬度和145°E附近的经度范围内。再推理：13°多表示该岛在赤道以北，约145°E属于太平洋西部海域；结合其位于北半球的太平洋部分，可判断它位于西北太平洋上。
method.CoT_answer_check_final: 先描述图像：图中是一座岛屿，绘在经纬度网格上；纬度标注约有13°20′、13°30′、13°40′，经度标注约有144°40′、144°50′，岛屿大致位于13°多的纬度和145°E附近的经度范围内。再推理：13°多表示该岛在赤道以北，约145°E属于太平洋西部海域；结合其位于北半球的太平洋部分，可判断它位于西北太平洋上。
method.CoT_qualify_0: 推理链符合要求：先描述图像中的岛屿、经纬网和可见经纬度标注，再根据约13°多纬度与144°40′—144°50′附近经度判断其在北半球、太平洋西部，最终得出“西北太平洋上”。建议若进一步完善，可明确说明图中纬度按常规应为北纬、经度为东经，以增强从坐标到方位判断的可验证性。
method.CoT_final: 先描述图像：图中是一座岛屿，绘在经纬度网格上；纬度标注约有13°20′、13°30′、13°40′，经度标注约有144°40′、144°50′，岛屿大致位于13°多的纬度和145°E附近的经度范围内。再推理：13°多表示该岛在赤道以北，约145°E属于太平洋西部海域；结合其位于北半球的太平洋部分，可判断它位于西北太平洋上。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the latitude and longitude labels around the island: about 13°20′–13°40′N and 144°40′–144°50′E; note the island lies entirely near 13°N, 145°E.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question wording to know the required output is the ocean and directional part of that ocean, not hemisphere or country.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use world map knowledge: coordinates near 13°N, 145°E are in the Pacific Ocean, specifically its western/northwestern part; east longitudes around 145°E in low northern latitudes correspond to the western Pacific basin.

method.method_draft: First describe the map as a small elongated island on a coordinate grid near 13°N, 145°E. Recognize this combination of outline and position as Guam or an island in the Mariana archipelago. Then recall that Guam/Mariana Islands are located in the western North Pacific. Report the location as the northwestern Pacific Ocean.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一幅带经纬网的岛屿轮廓图，岛屿形状狭长，纬度标注约为13°20′—13°40′N，经度标注约为144°40′—144°50′E，整体位置接近13°N、145°E。
推理：13°N、145°E附近且轮廓狭长的岛屿，可判断为关岛或马里亚纳群岛一带。关岛/马里亚纳群岛位于北太平洋西部，因此图示岛屿位于西北太平洋上。

It is distinct from directly classifying the ocean solely from coordinate ranges, though it still checks the coordinates as supporting evidence.
planner_metadata.image_role: Observe the narrow north-south island shape and its grid position near 13°N and 145°E, matching Guam in the Mariana region; the river markings are incidental and not needed for the ocean-location judgment.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt's phrase “图示岛屿位于哪个大洋的什么方位” to frame the answer as a regional-ocean description rather than the island name.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use geographic knowledge that Guam and the Mariana Islands lie in Micronesia in the western North Pacific Ocean. Therefore the broader ocean location is the northwest Pacific/western North Pacific.
